newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Dutch bank eyes private wealth in Geneva.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bank eyes private wealth in Geneva.

text.p: Dutch F. van Lanschot Bankiers has opened a branch in Switzerland's private banking hub of Geneva, bankers said on Thursday.
The bank, which already has an operation in Zurich, hopes to lure the private savings of the estimated 20,000-strong Dutch community living in Geneva and nearby regions, they said.

The bank is the latest foreign newcomer to Geneva's private banking scene, where the arrival of Wall Street powerhouses such as Merrill Lynch has put an end to the cosy world of Swiss private bankers and raised competition.
More than 40 percent of the world's private offshore wealth is in Switzerland, where private assets under management are estimated at some $1.8 trillion.
